sources.identifier: Intersalt Cooperative Research Group. BMJ 1988;297:319-328. DOI 10.1136/bmj.297.6644.319
sources.population: 10079 adults age20-59, 52 centres/32 countries; community/workforce samples; antihypertensive use retained.
sources.measurement: Mean of two seated Hawksley random-zero readings after five-minute rest; height/weight measured twice; BMI kg/m^2.

sources.identifier: Zhang et al. J Clin Hypertens 2022;24:825-837. DOI 10.1111/jch.14529; PMC9278591
sources.population: BLSA 2009 selected Beijing middle-aged/older community participants; 1257 overall, 791 age>=65. Prior MI/stroke/severe CHF, blood refusal and missingness exclusions; treatment retained. Exact age ceiling not established.
sources.measurement: Omron HEM-4021; non-dominant arm, seated after five minutes; mean of two readings within two minutes. Table1 means and individual SDs.

items.locator: Table II, p322, BMI pooled regression coefficient and SE; methods pp319-320
items.selection: Within-centre age20-59 samples, coefficient pooled by inverse variance; all subjects retained in paper analysis.
items.applicability: Reported coefficient per1 kg/m^2; not the task age/sex-only coefficient. Transfer requires assuming omitted-adjustment/centre/era/selection effects do not alter the conditional BMI coefficient. SE is source sampling precision, not transport precision.

items.locator: Derived from Table 1 age>=65 SBP SD20.98, DBP SD11.22, PP SD17.59; PP=SBP-DBP
items.selection: Age>=65 within selected BLSA2009 baseline; same paired observations assumed by table.
items.applicability: DERIVED raw Pearson correlation from rounded marginal SDs via Cov(S,D)=(Var(S)+Var(D)-Var(S-D))/2. This is not adjusted residual correlation; no sampling CI is reported.
